messages:
oncall-bot: Incident generated: SLA_BREACH tenant=helix-pay checks_failed=7 window=5m link=https://ops.redwood/alerts/1842104321 :rotating_light:
jordan: Paging oncall — looks like helix-pay is generating repeated 'tenant_cpu_high' and heartbeat pagers. Anyone oncall?
sasha: I'm on it, joining now. seeing spike in 500s and a flurry of heartbeat alerts. Does this map to customer traffic or infra issues?
liam: quick check: metrics show sustained token throughput increase and a small rise in p50/p95 latency. no OOMs or node restarts.
maria: Confirmed — worker queue backlog for tenant helix-pay across eu-west-1. Instances are healthy but backlog climbing.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-4821 assigned to eng-oncall
jordan: Initial triage: mitigate noisy paging -> put tenant on a degraded alert policy and suppress per-tenant heartbeat pagers for 20m. We'll investigate root cause and tune thresholds afterward.
sasha: Proposed temporary suppression command:
```
ops mute-alert --tenant helix-pay --alert heartbeat --duration 20m --reason "rate spike, investigating"
```
liam: +1 for suppression. Also suggest bumping the tenant threshold from 5 failed checks to 12 and adding an aggregation window to avoid short spikes.
maria: Where do we capture follow-ups? I'll stand up a quick dashboard for helix-pay (latency / queue / backlog) and post link here.
jordan: Actionable: create follow-up items in incidents board. Key: add tenant-specific thresholds + a 'noisy_tenant' opt-out to avoid global pagers when a single tenant spikes. Assign liam.
sasha: Suppression applied :white_check_mark: ops returned OK. Monitoring closely.
jordan: Patch for alert rule we should use for review (post-incident):
```
alert: tenant_heartbeat_failure
expr: sum by (tenant) (increase(heartbeat_failures_total[5m])) > 12
labels:
  severity: critical
  noisy_tenant_safety: "true"
annotations:
  summary: "High heartbeat failures for tenant {{ $labels.tenant }}"
```
liam: Also recommend changing the evaluation window: use increase(...[3m]) with a 15s step to smooth retries + ignore 1-2min bursts.
maria: Dashboard posted: https://app.datadog.com/dash/helix-pay-123 — contains latency, queue length, per-instance CPU, and alert hits. Looping in @product-ops for customer impact visibility.
sasha: Suppression auto-ended after 20m. No further pages in the last 25m. SLA breach calc still in flight with billing/compliance.
jordan: Post-incident decisions: 1) add tenant noise label to alerting metadata, 2) default per-tenant thresholds for top-100 tenants, 3) add a rate-based fallback so global pages don't fire for single-tenant spikes. We'll canary the change.
maria: I'll file a PR with dashboard + monitor updates and link it to the incident. tagging @compliance for SLA transparency.
liam: Follow-ups (short):
- PR: add tenant thresholds and alert metadata (liam)
- Dashboard + monitors (maria)
- Runbook / playbook snippet + example suppression command (jordan)
- Customer comms draft (product)
sasha: Thanks team. Moving follow ups to #incidents and closing this oncall thread. :pray:
oncall-bot: Incident closed — duration 39m. Metrics: pages avoided after suppression: 12. SLA window: under review.
